Generate main Pew scenarios

Source: R/scenarios.R
base_object_generator.Rd

Function for creating unresolved projection-objects

Usage

base_object_generator(
  object_name,
  steps = 10,
  light_migration = TRUE,
  light_switching = TRUE,
  post_switch = FALSE
)

Arguments

object_name

Character; name of the projection scenario — required

steps

Numeric; number of 5-year projection periods to simulate (default 10)

light_migration

Logical; if TRUE, migration output is stored in abbreviated form to reduce memory usage. Recommended when running multiple projections (default TRUE)

light_switching

Logical; if TRUE, switching output is stored in abbreviated form to reduce memory usage. Recommended when running multiple projections (default TRUE)

post_switch

Logical; controls how religious switching is tracked across periods. If FALSE (default), individuals who have switched religion remain in the general population and may switch again in subsequent steps. If TRUE, those who have switched are moved into separate post-switch columns and excluded from further switching. Forwarded to both `create_country_list()` and `create_projection_object()`.

Value

A single projection object

See also

test_object_generator for a lightweight 3-country 1-step variant, project to run the returned object, save_csv_all and save_plots_all to export results. vignette("conducting-projections") for the full projection workflow.

Examples

Main_1 <- base_object_generator(object_name = "SC1",
  steps = 10,
  light_migration = TRUE,
  light_switching = TRUE
)
